about: Reviewed exceptions for the CI security scans (make ci-security). Every waiver names one exact finding, an owner, a reviewer other than the owner, the review date and an expiry date. An invalid, expired or unused waiver fails CI.

waivers.reason: False positive. The generic-api-key rule matched the word 'token' next to the public SHA-256 hashes of the two SEC source files (submissions 47e4383b..., companyfacts 73a86c6a...; see docs/evidence/sec-research.md and docs/evidence/recovery-independent-review.md). The coordinator checked privately that none of the protected local credential values occurs on that line. The text is in committed history, so a history scan will always see it; only this exact finding is waived.
